name: enrich_dossier
description: Reads a candidate's existing deterministic dossier and the role context, then produces a richer, founder-voice rewrite plus a refined score and next-action. The deterministic parser gives the baseline; this agent layers real understanding on top — analyzing what the candidate actually shipped, matching specific accomplishments to rubric points, flagging genuine concerns. Never mutates state — output is consumed by the `apply_dossier_enrichment` function downstream.

candidate_id.description: UUID of the candidate to enrich.

enriched_dossier_markdown.description: The full rewritten dossier markdown — replaces /candidates/<id>/dossier.md verbatim.

refined_score.description: Score 0–10 against the role rubric, refined from the deterministic baseline.

refined_next_action.description: One concrete next step the founder should take. Max 120 chars.

reasoning_note.description: One sentence explaining why the score moved (or didn't). Used in the audit trail, never shown to candidates.
